_doc: One file per place; see places_build.py. Amounts in BDT. The debt component and history are refreshed by pipeline/fetch_bangladesh.py from the official source named below; edit wording here, not numbers.
name: Bangladesh
publisher: Finance Division, Ministry of Finance of Bangladesh
title: Bangladesh Debt Clock: Live Government Debt, Official Data
headline: government debt
subject: The People's Republic of Bangladesh
sum_note: Bangladesh's total government debt (domestic and external), quarter-end, from the Finance Division's Quarterly Debt Bulletin.
scope_note: This is "Total Debt (A+B)" in the government debt stock table of the Finance Division's Quarterly Debt Bulletin: domestic debt (banking and non-bank sources, including national savings certificates) plus external debt, in taka. The Bulletin gives the stock at each fiscal year-end (30 June) and at the latest quarter-end. It is the gross government debt; it does not include the guarantees the government has given to state-owned enterprises, which the Bulletin reports separately.
trend_why: The Bulletin gives each 30 June and the latest quarter-end, so we use the change since the 2025 fiscal year-end rather than twelve months back.
legend: Bangladesh's government debt is reported at period-end. Issuance happens in lumps at auctions and maturities, so the live number is a straight-line projection between official figures, shown here next to them.
next_update: The Finance Division publishes the Quarterly Debt Bulletin some months after each quarter closes; this page re-bases to it automatically on the next daily build after it appears.

population.source_name: World Bank, World Development Indicators, Population, total (SP.POP.TOTL), Bangladesh, 2025 (UN Population Division and national statistical offices)
population.method_short: World Bank 2025 population estimate, all ages

components.label: Bangladesh government debt
components.source_name: Finance Division, Quarterly Debt Bulletin, Table 6 Government Debt Stock, Total Debt (A+B), crore taka
components.source_locator: Table 6 "Government Debt Stock", row "C. Total Debt (A+B)", columns for each 30 June and the latest quarter-end (read from the bulletin PDF)
components.includes: Gross government debt in taka: domestic debt (banking sources, treasury bills and bonds, national savings certificates and the provident fund) plus external debt. Government guarantees to state-owned enterprises are not included.

notes: Why the Bulletin: it is the Finance Division's own debt publication and states the total with its domestic and external parts. The fetcher checks that the two parts add up to the total.
The Bulletin gives each fiscal year-end (30 June) and the latest quarter-end; the trend is the change from the 30 June 2025 fiscal year-end to the latest quarter-end.
Currency: Bangladeshi taka, from crore taka in the Bulletin (1 crore is 10 million). The World Debt Clock converts at the US Treasury's quarter-end rate for the taka.
trend_pace: the pace since the 2025 fiscal year-end (30 June)
